about_the_game:
Fpv Labs is not just another simulator – it is your virtual spot, your training ground, and your creative space to experience FPV the way it’s meant to be.


Core Features

  • Ultra-realistic FPV quadcopter physics

  • Physically-based flight dynamics with a real PID system

  • Build, save, and tune your own drone presets

  • Handcrafted, real-world inspired locations

  • Advanced crash and impact behavior

  • Accurate propwash and turbulence simulation

  • Wind simulation

  • Realistic FPV goggle OSD

  • Foliage collision system

  • Advanced sound design

A New Standard in FPV Simulation

From the very beginning, our goal was to create a simulator that doesn’t just look good – but feels right.
Every flight should bring the same intensity and excitement as flying your real quad at a real spot, without the risk of a crash.

With true-to-life physics and flight dynamics, every movement feels grounded and natural. Crashes are simulated realistically, so your drone reacts exactly as you’d expect.

Build, Save and Tune

Design your own drone presets using real values. Adjust flight behavior and physics in real time until it flies exactly like your quad.
All of this is managed through an intuitive, easy-to-use parameter system that can be accessed even mid-flight.

Handcrafted Maps

We want every map to capture the rich details and atmosphere of a real FPV spot.
Our maps are handcrafted, inspired by real-world locations, and refined with new lines, gaps, and structures – making each location a unique freestyle playground.

Currently, two maps are available at Early Access launch, with many more to come, shaped by the interests of our community.

  • Chemical Plant Bando
    Based on a well-known abandoned site near Berlin, this map is packed with gaps and freestyle opportunities – a dream for every pilot.

  • Rural Wilds
    Inspired by European countryside landscapes, this map offers fields, forests, and natural lines that every FPV pilot knows.

Fpv Labs pushes flight feel and physics to the limit

  • With a real PID system, flying feels sharp and responsive – just like a real quad.

  • Propwash and turbulence are simulated accurately, making every dive and orbit feel alive.

  • Throwing and catching your quad in the air behaves exactly as it would in reality.

All of this helps to seamlessly transfer your simulator training to real flights.
